user.title: Connect Voltdeer RS073
user.description: Enter the meter's local IP address or hostname. The integration reads the JSON status from the device's HTTP root page on port 80.

error.cannot_connect: Could not connect to the meter. Check that it is online and reachable over HTTP.
error.invalid_response: The response does not contain the expected em:0 meter data.

init.title: Sensor options
init.description: Choose sensor groups, exclude unwanted sensors, and set how often the meter is polled. Exclusions accept comma-separated leaf keys or full dotted JSON paths.
